name: Emergency cut, price history only - no maturity records at all
question: On a machine whose store holds the 45-day price seed and nothing else, does an inter-meeting decision still leave every change column reading its own contract?
notes: ECB: on 20-Jul-26 the tickers were not numbered the way the meeting calendar implies, so the change columns follow the strip's own prices instead. This is normal after an unscheduled meeting; if there has not been one, the calendar in config/meetings.json needs checking.
